title: Adult Snowboard Rental Package for Snowbasin and Powder Mountain
includes: Damage Insurance. Can be purchased in-shop $3 - $4 per day based on item (not included)
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Travelers should have at least a moderate level of physical fitness
Adult riders must have a shoe size 7 and up to be accommodated with this package
policies: You are permitted to pick up your skis the night before you ski after 4pm, so you can enjoy a full day on the slopes. You have until 10:00 am the day after your final ski day to return the gear.
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Hit the slopes with this adult snowboard package for intermediate boarders! Rental period is 24 hours, giving you plenty of time to enjoy "the greatest snow on earth."
